title: The Seven Bowls of God's Wrath

questions.question: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple telling the seven angels, "Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the ____ of God."
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:1 (ESV): "Then I heard a loud voice from the temple telling the seven angels, 'Go and pour out on the earth the seven bowls of the wrath of God.'"

questions.question: So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and harmful and painful ____ came upon the people who bore the mark of the beast...
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:2 (ESV): "So the first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth, and harmful and painful sores came upon the people who bore the mark of the beast and worshiped its image."

questions.question: The second angel poured out his bowl into the ____, and it became like the blood of a corpse, and every living thing died...
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:3 (ESV): "The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became like the blood of a corpse, and every living thing died that was in the sea."

questions.question: The third angel poured out his bowl into the ____ and the springs of water, and they became blood.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:4 (ESV): "The third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of water, and they became blood."

questions.question: And I heard the angel in charge of the waters say, "Just are you, O Holy One, who is and who was, for you brought these judgments. For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them ____ to drink."
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:5-6 (ESV): "And I heard the angel in charge of the waters say, 'Just are you, O Holy One, who is and who was, for you brought these judgments. For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. It is what they deserve!'"

questions.question: And I heard the ____ saying, "Yes, Lord God the Almighty, true and just are your judgments!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:7 (ESV): "And I heard the altar saying, 'Yes, Lord God the Almighty, true and just are your judgments!'"

questions.question: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the ____, and it was allowed to scorch people with ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:8 (ESV): "The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was allowed to scorch people with fire."

questions.question: They were scorched by the fierce heat, and they ____ the name of God who had power over these plagues. They did not repent and give him glory.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:9 (ESV): "They were scorched by the fierce heat, and they cursed the name of God who had power over these plagues. They did not repent and give him glory."

questions.question: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into ____...
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:10 (ESV): "The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was plunged into darkness. People gnawed their tongues in anguish"

questions.question: and cursed the God of heaven for their pain and sores. They did not ____ of their deeds.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:11 (ESV): "and cursed the God of heaven for their pain and sores. They did not repent of their deeds."

questions.question: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river ____, and its water was dried up, to prepare the way for the kings from the east.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:12 (ESV): "The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, to prepare the way for the kings from the east."

questions.question: And I saw, coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits like ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:13 (ESV): "And I saw, coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits like frogs."

questions.question: And they assembled them at the place that in Hebrew is called ____.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:16 (ESV): "And they assembled them at the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon."

questions.question: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne, saying, "____!"
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:17 (ESV): "The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne, saying, 'It is done!'"

questions.question: And every ____ fled away, and no ____ were to be found.
questions.explanation: Revelation 16:20 (ESV): "And every island fled away, and no mountains were to be found."

key_verse_text: ("Behold, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake, keeping his garments on, that he may not go about naked and be seen exposed!")
